experiment.description: Each session has fixed eight channel gains and independent noise realizations for old/current/validation background, pilot, calibration and evaluation. Session scenario used only by simulator and grouping; inference receives measured background, reference availability and pilot, not scenario/family. Stable old model is known prior. No real radio or external blind custodian.

monitor.covariance: Regularized symmetric generalized eigenvalue ratio max(abs(log lambda)) comparing current and previous covariance, plus absolute mean-envelope lag-one correlation difference. Drift if log ratio > log(1.8) or lag delta > .20. Fixed before execution; report empirical false alarms and detection.
monitor.reference: Known independent injected pilot with randomized +/-1 signal (not science event). Fit reference response to pilot, bound abs slope + 3 standard errors <= .12 (nominal heuristic, not guaranteed coverage under correlation). Independently require background reference explains >= 15% average channel variance on held-out current background using training coefficient. Reference availability explicit; no pilot or bad transfer => no subtraction.
monitor.recalibration: If measured drift, fit fresh covariance and temporal precision on current independent background; otherwise retain old fit unless reference validity changes. Build null score calibration by injecting symmetric templates into independent signal-free synthetic background windows under same session noise law, no science samples or labels. Calibration at both epochs uses separate windows, fixed bin and quantile rules, lock before evaluation; separate validation nulls.
monitor.routing: Reference qualified => FULL; otherwise EQ (preserve original channel average, no blind covariance removal). If held-out current null validation >5%, quarantine directional output; raw and baseline candidates always retained. Unsupported bin abstains. No automatic veto. Drift monitor has no guarantee for event-only shifts; test explicitly, do not tune.

comparators.old: R1.5B FULL with prior background and historical per-regime lock; old prior regime known from simulated instrument setup, reference availability prior metadata. EQ with current independent calibration on identical samples as fair comparator.
comparators.new: Homeostasis routes using measured monitor and pilot. Candidate retention is separate from directional decision; track paired strong directional losses vs EQ and old FULL, no claiming retained candidate equals correctly classified.
comparators.mirror: Reverse all time axes including background, pilot, event and references, ensure route/qualification invariant and sign-flip scores. No hidden labels. Mirror for all eval.

gates.drift: Per seed persistent shift detected, stable ref not flagged; event-only shift diagnostic, not guaranteed observable.
gates.reference: Per seed reject REF_LEAK and unavailable ALIGNED_NO_REF; qualify stable and persistent shift when pilot and heldout background support; report false rejection.
gates.stable_and_shift: Each seed STABLE_REF and PERSISTENT_SHIFT: weak correct >= current EQ+10 pp; wrong <=5%; null <=5%; strong >=85%; zero paired strong directional losses versus EQ.
gates.protection: Each seed IID and ALIGNED_NO_REF, REF_LEAK: null <=5%, weak wrong <=5%, strong >=85%, zero paired strong losses versus EQ. All raw candidates retained in all scenarios.
gates.event_only: Report null <=5%, weak wrong <=5%, strong >=85%, zero paired strong losses as separate stress gate; expect possible fail because no independent event-time monitor.
gates.reconstruction: Run unchanged R15 on IID double/clipped raw means; pooled double median <= linear and R14. No directional veto of reconstruction.

spiral: Canonical five axes; measured covariance eigenspectrum, pilot bound, validation error, chosen path and source-bound state hashes. Competing explanations for drift (gain, common noise, reference leakage, event-only) remain unless measured; synthetic ground truth only for exam grading.
scientific_ceiling: Synthetic tests only, no physical causality or carrier claim, no real qualified off-band radio data, no production or main changes.
